title: HS40091: Derivatives
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisites: HS30097 and BM60011Course ContentsIntroduction to Derivatives;
Determination of Forward and Futures Price; Hedging using Futures: Basic
principles. Arguments for and against Hedging; Interest Rate Market: Types of
Rates; Interest Rate Swap and its Valuation: the Comparative Advantage
Arguments; Mechanics of Option Market; Introduction to Binomial Trees: One Step
Binomial Model; Risk-Neutral Valuation; Two-Step Binomial Trees; Binomial Trees
in Practice. Delta; Black-Scholes Model; Value at Risk (VAR): Historical
Simulation, Model-Building Approach, Linear Model, Quadratic Model, Monet Carlo
Simulation, Comparison of Approaches, Stress Testing and Back Testing,
Principal Component Analysis.
